body:
## Pull request overview

This PR adds comprehensive documentation for ObjectStack's three-layer access control architecture in Fumadocs MDX format. The documentation explains the interaction between RLS (database-level), Permissions (application CRUD), and Sharing (business rules) with the precedence formula `Final Access = RLS ∩ Permission ∩ Sharing`.

**Changes:**
- Documents complete permission model with practical examples from multi-tenant sales organizations
- Provides test case matrices demonstrating precedence behavior across layers
- Includes migration guidance from RBAC and Salesforce permission models
- Adds performance optimization and security best practices sections

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 2 out of 2 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| content/docs/objectos/permission-model.mdx | Comprehensive 526-line permission model documentation with examples, test cases, schema references, and implementation guidance following Fumadocs format |
| content/docs/objectos/meta.json | Adds "permission-model" to ObjectOS documentation navigation |
